title: Accumulator instances share state unexpectedly
prompt: The module starter/accumulator.py defines an Accumulator class. Each Accumulator should maintain its own independent list of items, and the list should start empty for every new instance unless an initial list is explicitly provided to the constructor. When a second Accumulator is created and items are appended to it, the first Accumulator must not see those items and vice versa. The grader checks that two independently-constructed Accumulator instances have separate item lists and that appending to one does not affect the other. Do not edit the tests.
